samuel1.19.p1.b1.text: Then Saul ordered his son Jonathan and all his servants to kill David. But Jonathan delighted greatly in David,

samuel1.19.p1.b2.text: My father Saul intends to kill you. Be on your guard in the morning; find a secret place and hide there.

samuel1.19.p1.b3.text: … he has not sinned against you. In fact, his actions have been highly beneficial to you. … so why would you sin against innocent blood by killing David for no reason?

samuel1.19.p1.b4.text: David will not be put to death.

samuel1.19.p2.b1.text: When war broke out again, David went out and fought the Philistines … they fled before him.

samuel1.19.p2.b2.text: But as Saul was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand, a spirit of distress from the LORD came upon him. While David was playing the harp,

samuel1.19.p2.b3.text: … But the spear struck the wall and David eluded him, ran away, and escaped that night.

samuel1.19.p3.b1.text: Then Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and kill him in the morning.

samuel1.19.p3.b2.text: If you do not run for your life tonight, tomorrow you will be dead!

samuel1.19.p3.b3.text: So Michal lowered David from the window, and he ran away and escaped.

samuel1.19.p4.b1.text: Then Michal took a household idol and laid it in the bed, placed some goat hair on its head, and covered it with a garment.

samuel1.19.p4.b3.text: Why did you deceive me like this? You sent my enemy away and he has escaped!

samuel1.19.p4.b4.text: He said to me, ‘Help me get away, or I will kill you!’

samuel1.19.p5.b1.text: So David ran away and escaped. And he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him.

samuel1.19.p5.b2.text: Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

samuel1.19.p5.b3.text: When Saul was told that David was at Naioth in Ramah,

samuel1.19.p6.b1.text: he sent messengers to capture him.

samuel1.19.p6.b2.text: But when they saw the group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel leading them, the Spirit of God came upon them, and Saul’s messengers also began to prophesy.

samuel1.19.p6.b3.text: When this was reported to Saul, he sent more messengers, but they began to prophesy as well.

samuel1.19.p6.b4.text: So Saul tried again and sent messengers a third time, and even they began to prophesy.

samuel1.19.p7.b3.text: … But the Spirit of God came upon even Saul, and he walked along prophesying until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

samuel1.19.p7.b4.text: Is Saul also among the prophets?
